notes: Interface implemented by ~8 config/widget-component classes (ConfigValueProvider, HeapInfoRecord, MinimapSpriteRenderer, ParticleEmitterDef/ParticleEmitterDefExt, RsaVarbitHandler, WorldMapLabel and its subclasses WorldMapAreaLabel/WorldMapIconLabel/WorldMapPolygonIconLabel/WorldMapTextLabel). Each override just returns a distinct static ProjectileFactory singleton constant (e.g. OrientationRotator.aProjectileFactory_2045) with no real computation - it's a pure type-tag getter. Sole consumer is DualMaterialContainer.method1000(bool, configTypeProvider), which calls configTypeProvider.method51(120.toByte()) and does a chain of reference-equality checks against those singleton constants to decide which concrete Lifecycle/component wrapper class to instantiate (a poor-man's sealed-class dispatch). The Byte param is always a decoy guard (e.g. 'if (i < 116) return null') never meaningfully varied by callers.
